_comment_model: Model filename (relative to models/) or full path. Can also be set via startup.default_model.
_comment_api_port_secondary: Secondary management-only port (no inference). Reserved for future use.
_comment_ctx_size: Context window size in tokens. Minimum 4096 enforced. Higher values allow longer conversations but increase RAM/VRAM usage. Auto-tuned by system_optimizer.py.
_comment_gpu: n_gpu_layers: number of layers to offload to GPU (99 = all layers). gpu_type: nvidia/intel/amd/apple_silicon.
_comment_threading: threads: CPU threads for generation. threads_batch: CPU threads for prompt processing.
_comment_sampling: Sampling parameters for llama.cpp (ignored on macOS — use mlx_sampling instead).
_comment_kv: KV cache quantization type: turbo, q8_0, q4_0, none — for llama.cpp only. TurboQuant requires --flash-attn.
_comment_kv_quant: Native KV cache quantization: turbo (TurboQuant build), q8_0, q4_0, none.
_comment_numa: numa_mode: distribute (multi-socket) or none (single socket). Auto-detected by system_optimizer.py.
_comment_prompt_cache: Enable prompt caching. WARNING: defaults to 8GB limit which can cause OOM on constrained systems.
_comment_llama_cpp: MoE (Mixture of Experts) and memory-mapping flags — for llama.cpp only.
_comment_mlx_a: KV cache size cap — prevents unbounded growth (null = unlimited/model default).
_comment_mlx_b: Sampling parameters exposed for UI control (macOS/MLX only).
_comment_mlx_c: Enable Metal performance optimizations (env vars set before mlx import).
_comment_mlx_d: Memory limit as fraction of RAM (null = don't set, 0.65 = 65% of unified memory).
_comment_mlx_e: Native KV quantization — mutually exclusive with asymmetric mlx_kv_quant.
_comment_mlx_f: Asymmetric KV quantization (K bits / V bits) — mutual exclusive with mlx_kv_quant_native.
_comment_reserved_startup: startup: Reserved for startup pipeline control.
